description: This file defines a data model and logic for managing and displaying health status information of a system, including snapshot structures, health state enumeration, and a singleton store class that handles periodic refreshes and status derivation. It includes network communication with a control channel to fetch health data and provides UI-related state based on health conditions.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for periodically fetching, storing, and providing reactive status about the system's health, including managing refresh cycles and interpreting snapshot data.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Test-only method to manually set the health snapshot and last error.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins periodic automatic health status refresh.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic health status refresh.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest health data from the control channel, updating internal state.

methods.name: isChannelHealthy
methods.description: Determines if a health channel summary indicates a healthy state.

methods.name: describeProbeFailure
methods.description: Generates a human-readable message describing why a health probe failed.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Finds the primary linked channel in the health snapshot.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds an alternative healthy channel if the linked one is unhealthy or absent.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a summary string describing the latest failure condition based on snapshot data.
